:hom: The set of homomorphisms between two objects.
:endo: Endomorphisms — homomorphisms of an object to itself.
:normal: Normal subgroup, or a two-sided ideal.
:semidirect: Semidirect product, normal factor on the left.
:lsemidirect: Semidirect product, normal factor on the right.
:mod: Binary mod operator inside an expression.
:units: Unit group, written as a × superscript.
:iso: Isomorphism arrow with a tilde above it.
:char: Characteristic of a ring or field.
:deg: Degree of a polynomial or field extension.
